json.title: Gangtok Pink Dawn
json.logline: A family winter trip to Gangtok culminates in the unforgettable sight of Himalayan snow peaks turning vibrant pink at sunrise.

palette: soft sage green in distant foliage
character_rules: one protagonist appears in every scene with the same face, hair length and build
wardrobe is identical from the first scene to the last
the face stays readable in at least three-quarter profile
style_bible.lighting: cinematic low-angle golden-hour light with gentle halation and soft falloff
style_bible.medium: loose gouache painting with visible brush strokes and softly blended colour

events.visual: Quiet morning twilight over the mountain town
Painterly gouache wash spreads soft warm light across the valley
Rhythmic momentum builds as sky brightens
Snow-capped mountain peaks ignite in vibrant dawn pink light
Golden memory fragments layer over the glowing alpine horizon
Light softens into warm pastel hues across the ridges
Final warm piano note sustains over the silent mountain crests

scenes.camera_note: Gentle slow push toward the face in quiet morning gloom
scenes.action: The young man turns his head slightly toward the soft morning light breaking through a window.
scenes.setting: Dimly lit guest house bedroom in Gangtok with distant mountain silhouettes framed by a window.

scenes.camera_note: Slow horizontal drift showing mountain scale and layered depth
scenes.action: The family stands together by a mountain overlook gazing across the vast mist-filled valley.
scenes.setting: Winding Gangtok mountain road surrounded by tall dark pine trees and distant misty ridges.

scenes.camera_note: Slow upward tilt following light climbing glass
scenes.action: Melting frost glides down a glass windowpane revealing distant pine tree branches.
scenes.setting: Frosty wooden glass window looking out onto an alpine Sikkim hillside.

scenes.action: The young man leans gently over a wooden balcony railing looking up at the sky.
scenes.setting: Hotel balcony overlooking the quiet sleeping town of Gangtok under twilight skies.

scenes.camera_note: Sweeping pull out revealing the grand scale of pink Himalayan peaks
scenes.action: The snowy peaks of Kanchenjunga glow in vivid rose pink under the rising sun.
scenes.setting: Panoramic vista of colossal Himalayan snow mountains turning brilliant pink above Gangtok.

scenes.camera_note: Floating painterly movement through layered golden morning memories
scenes.action: The young man smiles faintly as golden sunlight reflects across his glasses.
scenes.setting: Warm sunlit wooden terrace with glowing mountain mist in the background.

scenes.camera_note: Gentle backwards drift giving space and quiet finality
scenes.action: The young man softly relaxes his shoulders looking out at the illuminated valley.
scenes.setting: Peaceful morning terrace in Gangtok under a soft warm sky.
